scripts.build: sh -c 'if command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1 && rustup target list --installed 2>/dev/null | grep -q wasm32v1-none; then cargo build --target wasm32v1-none --release --workspace; else echo "Rust/wasm32v1-none target not available; skipping contract build (handled by the CI unit-tests job)"; fi'
